competitor_alerts: dallaskosher.org remains the authority directory ranking at or near #1 for nearly every target keyword (food, restaurant, catering, delivery, Shabbat). The Hungry Rooster still does not appear in its Restaurants or Catering directories — this gap flagged last week is unresolved.

Shi-Ya Modern Asian Cuisine — the 100% kosher sushi concept that opened inside Meat Point (7114 Campbell Rd) in June 2026 — continues to surface in 'new kosher restaurant Dallas' searches, adding variety to the competitive set.
Simcha Kosher Catering (11 Yelp reviews) and A Taste of the World both still outrank us on 'kosher catering Dallas' and 'Jewish catering Dallas', where we sit in the last position on page 1.

Our own /shabbat page still returns only 'Loading this week's Shabbat menu...' with no crawlable content on fetch — the same issue identified last week — while A Taste of the World has a fully built-out, indexable /shabbat page and it shows in results for that exact keyword.

recommendations.action: Still outstanding from last week: server-render the /shabbat page. It continues to return only 'Loading this week's Shabbat menu...' on a direct fetch, with the real menu injected client-side.
recommendations.reason: 'Shabbat meals Dallas' is a target keyword and we still don't rank for it at all. A competitor with a fully crawlable Shabbat page (A Taste of the World) does show up. This is the most likely reason for zero visibility on our most on-brand keyword.

recommendations.action: Still outstanding from last week: every subpage's canonical tag (/menu, /catering, /shabbat, /review) points back to the homepage root (https://thehungryroostertx.com) instead of itself — confirmed again this run.
recommendations.reason: A homepage-pointing canonical tells Google the subpage is a duplicate and not worth indexing separately, which likely suppresses /catering from ranking on 'kosher catering Dallas' despite relevant content.

recommendations.action: Still outstanding from last week: get listed on dallaskosher.org's Restaurants and Catering directories.
recommendations.reason: This single directory ranks at or near #1 for 6 of our 7 target keywords. We remain absent from it two weeks running — the fastest available lever for page-1 visibility on 'kosher food Dallas', 'kosher restaurant Dallas', and 'Shabbat meals Dallas'.

recommendations.action: Add keyword-rich, Dallas-specific body copy to the /catering page. Its current visible text ('We pull up and feed your flock... Corporate. Schools. Weddings. Shiva.') never mentions 'Dallas' or 'kosher catering' explicitly.
recommendations.reason: Thin, non-geo-specific copy gives Google little to match against 'kosher catering Dallas' searches even once the canonical fix lands.

recommendations.reason: Structured data supports map-pack and rich-result eligibility for local searches; without confirmation this remains a blind spot for two consecutive audits.

recommendations.action: Claim or verify listings on Uber Eats, DoorDash, and Postmates under Dallas's 'kosher' category.
recommendations.reason: Every delivery-intent keyword ('kosher delivery Dallas', 'kosher meal delivery Texas') is fully owned by these marketplaces and we don't appear on any of their kosher category pages — this is ready-to-order traffic going entirely to competitors.

recommendations.action: Build a public, indexable reviews/testimonials page. The only reviews-related page is /review, a submission form with no visible testimonials (there is no /reviews page in the site's navigation).
recommendations.reason: Competitors display visible review counts (e.g., Simcha's 11 Yelp reviews) as a trust signal; a crawlable reviews page also adds fresh, naturally keyword-rich content.

recommendations.action: Give /menu, /catering, and /shabbat unique page titles and meta descriptions instead of reusing the homepage's identical tags (confirmed identical again this run).
recommendations.reason: Duplicate titles/descriptions across pages dilute relevance signals and click-through; unique, keyword-targeted tags help each page compete for its own term.

quick_wins: Fix the canonical tag on /menu, /catering, and /shabbat so each points to itself, not the homepage root — flagged last week and still unresolved.
Add a static fallback paragraph to /shabbat (e.g., 'Order Kosher Shabbat Meals for Dallas Delivery') so the page has crawlable content even before the JS menu loads.
Submit The Hungry Rooster to the dallaskosher.org Restaurants and Catering directories — still not listed after two weekly audits.
summary: For a second straight week, The Hungry Rooster appears only for 'kosher catering Dallas' and 'Jewish catering Dallas' — both in last position on page 1 — and is absent from the other five target keywords, including its most on-brand term, 'Shabbat meals Dallas'. The three technical issues flagged last week (homepage-pointing canonical tags, a JavaScript-only /shabbat page, and no listing on the dominant dallaskosher.org directory) are all still unresolved on this run's checks, and remain the most likely reasons visibility hasn't improved. New kosher sushi concept Shi-Ya continues to add to the competitive field inside Meat Point.
